jobA_trustedPreparation.why: Staging cannot freeze the corpus, assign opaque identifiers or write the post-freeze map without them.
does: verify the Stage 1 package against stage-1-contract-manifest.sha256
run staging and verify source images and the post-freeze map
verify the incumbent configuration pins and the production-source base-drift gate
build the allowlisted runtime bundle and generate its dependency closure
write the bundle manifest and run the pre-isolation bundle scan
jobA_trustedPreparation.isNotTruthFreeItselfNote: Job A is TRUSTED, not truth-free. Calling the whole workflow truth-free would be false. What is truth-free is the artifact it emits and the isolated job that consumes it.
jobA_trustedPreparation.receivesGovernedTruthNote: Job A PHYSICALLY reads a truth-bearing source. Showing it as 'governed truth: no' was wrong. See governedTruthAccess for exactly what it may read and what it may use.

governedTruthAccess.supersededClaim: Job A receives no governed truth.
governedTruthAccess.whyItWasFalse: The freeze script reads artifacts/issue-149-brand-current-baseline-failure-decomposition/per-case-attribution.json and accesses c.governedTruth.present to enforce the frozen 105/10 Brand-present split. Acceptable Brand values and other governed truth live in the same case objects, so they are physically in the process's address space whether or not they are used.
mayPhysicallyRead: acceptableValues and other truth fields that coexist in that source object
historical identity and source image paths
mayUseOnly: source-image path, SHA-256 and byte size
governedTruth.present, SOLELY for the preregistered 105/10 corpus-accounting assertion
PR #218 membership, for the frozen-subset assertion
mustNotUseAcceptableValuesOrTruthTextFor: any acquisition input or emitted field
governedTruthAccess.noninterferenceClaimIsBounded: Complete noninterference from governedTruth.present is NOT claimed: the script intentionally uses that flag for the 105/10 accounting assertion. What is claimed, and tested, is that acceptable Brand values and other truth TEXT do not influence the truth-free input manifest, the opaque ordering or the staged filenames.

jobA_trustedPreparation.distinctFromStage1TrustedStaging: Stage 1 trusted staging has ALREADY run: it froze and verified the corpus and generated the three committed artifacts. Stage 2 Job A additionally builds and scans the runtime bundle and emits the truth-free preparation artifact. Neither of those has happened.

actor2_postRunCommitProcess.authorization: explicit owner authorization, separate from the OCR run
preconditions: the Job C identity-leak report exists and is clean
actor2_postRunCommitProcess.appliesWhen: total evidence footprint is at or below 100 MB
actor2_postRunCommitProcess.evidenceInput: the verified workflow artifact — not a regenerated, re-serialized or locally rebuilt copy
mustDo: verify the outer artifact digest against the value the OCR job recorded
verify BOTH raw manifests (primary and repeat) against the artifact contents
verify the Job C identity-leak report is present and clean

stop after exact commitment and verification
mustNotDo: filter, subset or selectively omit any evidence file

use truth or historical identity as an input to any decision it makes
actor2_postRunCommitProcess.truthIsNotAnInputNote: Actor 2 makes no content-dependent decision at all: it commits the bytes it verified, or it fails.

haltCodes.ARTIFACT_DIGEST_MISMATCH: the downloaded artifact does not match the digest the OCR job recorded
haltCodes.RAW_MANIFEST_MISMATCH: a raw file's SHA-256 does not match its manifest entry
haltCodes.IDENTITY_VERIFIER_REPORT_MISSING_OR_UNCL: the Job C report is absent, unverifiable or reports a hit
haltCodes.COMMITTED_BYTES_DIFFER: a committed file's SHA-256 does not equal the artifact manifest entry

actor3_postFreezeEvaluationProcess.authorization: separate authorization again, after actor 2 stops for review
preconditions: the Job C identity-leak report exists and is clean
the raw evidence is committed and immutable
actor3_postFreezeEvaluationProcess.physicalExclusivityNote: Other processes can READ post-freeze/id-map.json — it is committed on this branch. What is exclusive is AUTHORIZATION to use it, and governed truth, for evaluation. An earlier revision claimed actor 3 was the only actor that may open the map; that was an access claim the design does not enforce.
mayUse: prior per-case classifications and PR #217/#218 records
actor3_postFreezeEvaluationProcess.mayNotModify: any raw evidence file, for any reason
